verdicts.REUSE-WITH-ATTRIBUTION: Files listed in allowedPaths may be vendored into third_party/<name>/ at pinnedSha by the operator or Architect and used with attribution. Empty allowedPaths means nothing is vendored yet and nothing may be used.
verdicts.PATTERNS-ONLY: Nothing is copied. The prose pattern cards already in research/ are the only bridge.
verdicts.EXCLUDED: Nothing is copied and no new patterns are drawn. Existing research/ pattern cards stand as recorded.
verdicts.DEV-TOOL-ONLY: A tool run on a developer or agent machine. Nothing it returns is committed, baked, cached or shipped.

thirdPartyLicences.otherNeedsAdr: any licence not listed above, ODbL-1.0 included, needs its own ADR before it is vendored
thirdPartyLicences.appliesTo: each allowedPaths item's spdx, never the entry: code items take a code licence, data items a dataOnly licence (DL-508)

entryName: REUSE-WITH-ATTRIBUTION entries only: name = the directory third_party/<name>/ and the <entry> argument of pnpm reuse:subset; the upstream repository name in lower case (DL-502, DL-617)
noticeLine: one third_party/NOTICE line per allowedPaths item, fields separated by ' | ': <name>/<path> | <spdx> | <creator> | <licence URL> [| modified]; 'modified' present exactly when the item's modified is true; copied verbatim into third-party-licenses.txt and credits.json (DL-523, DL-617)

allowedPathItem.path: path under third_party/<name>/ as committed; a field subset is <upstream path>.subset.json
allowedPathItem.spdx: SPDX id of this path; the root REUSE.toml annotates this path with the same id (DL-502)
allowedPathItem.fields: data subsets only: explicit allowlist of factual categorical fields (category, sector and similar enumerations), each as {name, note} where note is the reviewer's short statement that the field is authored upstream and not OSM- or Nominatim-derived; never a name, description, tagline, URL, logo, person or coordinate field, nor an address, city, neighbourhood or district, location, OSM id, building id or footprint-link field, or any other geocoded field (DL-523)
allowedPathItem.modified: true for a subset file or any changed file; its NOTICE and CC BY lines then say modified

excludedFieldRule: each excludedFieldPatterns item is a case-insensitive regular expression; license:scan and reuse:subset refuse an allowedPathItem fields name or a .subset.json key that any of them matches, so synonyms such as company, org, website, blurb or lat are caught. Values: each kept field is a closed enumeration of at most 32 distinct values in the subset; when DV_NAMES_REAL_JSON is set, the NameRegistry real-side matcher runs over every subset value (absent: SKIP line). Either failure drops the field (DL-648)
licenceFiles: REUSE-WITH-ATTRIBUTION entries only: [{path, spdx}], files under third_party/<name>/ copied verbatim at pinnedSha that carry the licence grants and credit lines: the upstream LICENSE, an Apache NOTICE when present, and the file or verbatim README excerpt (<file>.excerpt.md) that grants each item licence or gives its credit line; at least one per distinct allowedPaths spdx; exempt from the allowedPaths rule; emitted verbatim into third-party-licenses.txt and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt; Builders may read them with the allowedPaths files (DL-630)

entries.name: sf-bay-area-ai-atlas

fields.name: category
fields.note: upstream-authored sector classification of each record (21 values, e.g. AI Chips, Voice AI); research taxonomy, not OSM- or Nominatim-derived

fields.name: status
fields.note: upstream-authored corporate status from public reporting (5 values: independent, acquired, uncertain, relocated_out_of_bay, shut_down); not OSM- or Nominatim-derived

uses: app/render.js (Canvas 2D renderer: cached static frame plus animated overlay) as an optional starting point for the in-engine minimap and full map, re-expressed in the ENU frame

company dataset (CC-BY-4.0), vendored only as a subset file (<path>.subset.json, kind data, spdx CC-BY-4.0, modified) holding the factual categorical fields listed in its fields allowlist (category, sector and similar enumerations; no name, description, tagline, URL, logo, person or coordinate field, and no address, city, neighbourhood or district, location, OSM id, building id, footprint-link or other geocoded field), as seed data for the Business Tycoon ai-tooling sector; every location, coordinate or building-link field is ODbL-1.0 (Nominatim geocoding and OSM footprints, research/repos-world.md §2.3) and is never vendored; the district mix comes from the project's own OSM/DataSF bake; world points of interest only after a later decision-log entry
entries.attribution: SF-Bay-Area-AI-Atlas by Kenton-GMI, MIT License (code); company dataset CC BY 4.0: creator, licence URL https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ and "modified" when changed (credit line as given by the upstream LICENSE or README at pinnedSha, kept as a licenceFiles item)
entries.notes: Code MIT; map geometry ODbL; dataset CC BY 4.0 (research/repos-world.md §2; research/legal-ip-likeness.md §2.1); licence per allowedPaths item (app/render.js MIT code; dataset subset CC-BY-4.0 data). Atlas geometry is not vendored: the project's own OSM bake replaces it. Company and person names never enter third_party/ or content-private/: the operator adds the upstream dataset's company names only to the real side of the NameRegistry (DV_NAMES_REAL_JSON, never committed), each with a D-29 likeness tier (DL-615); shipped text uses invented names; logos are never vendored or shown. The vendoring PR (DL-502, DL-504) commits the dataset only through the subset tool of milestone M00f (pnpm reuse:subset); the review of app/render.js records that it holds no company names, no logo or image URLs and no coordinate tables, or the file stays out of allowedPaths. third_party/ is excluded from the names:lint source scan and is never bundled (ESLint no-restricted-imports and check:bundle, milestone M00f). Vendored 2026-10-19 by the Architect at pinnedSha 06163f70b22420d2b31754821affe80f796d6c59 (upstream HEAD that day): LICENSE verbatim (MIT code grant, the CC BY 4.0 company-dataset grant and the ODbL geometry and geocoding notice) and README.excerpt.md (the README Licence section verbatim, the dataset credit line); the dataset enters only as build/companies_merged.json.subset.json, written by pnpm reuse:subset from build/companies_merged.json (134 rows, fields category and status; every name, website, address, city, location, geocode, description, funding, source and note field dropped). Review of app/render.js at pinnedSha: no company names and no logo or image URLs, but it holds a latitude/longitude waypoint table (an aircraft path, lines 400-403) of unrecorded provenance, so under DL-502 step 5 it stays out of allowedPaths and M02c2 writes its Canvas 2D map from 02-world-maps.md section 2; re-admitting a copy without that table needs its own decision-log entry.

entries.notes: F-056; research/repos-world.md §4. Mapbox Product Terms forbid deriving or extracting content and caching or storing Licensed Map Content. Mapbox Product Terms 1.6 forbid deriving or extracting content, data or information, whether or not the output is committed. The operator's own token stays in their shell, never committed; it is not a Builder secret. Milestone M00f's Mapbox scan (license:scan over source, content, config, provenance records and dist; provenance:check on source.url) fails any Mapbox host, style URL or token prefix that lands in the repository or the build (DL-616). D-25 stands: no Mapbox runtime (default pending owner question Q-44). Revisit trigger: a web surface needs live search or routing that the baked geocoder and PMTiles cannot give (ADR-REUSE-01).
